source_basis.graph: umap.umap_.smooth_knn_dist and compute_membership_strengths; fuzzy set operation follows UMAP's sparse union/intersection expression.
source_basis.optimizer: umap.layouts.optimize_layout_euclidean with the installed _get_optimize_layout_euclidean_single_epoch_fn wrapped to record states after each epoch and ordered event prefix.

scoring.trustworthiness: sklearn.manifold.trustworthiness(X, embedding, n_neighbors=15); report fit and held-out transform independently. For each surface, compute the arithmetic mean of per-case/per-seed trustworthiness scores for implementation and reference, then gate on abs(implementation_mean-reference_mean) <= 0.02. This is intentionally not the stricter mean of per-run absolute gaps.
scoring.recall: Fit uses k=14 (= n_neighbors - 1; fit's kNN includes self), held-out transform query uses k=15 (= n_neighbors; bipartite search has no self slot). For each row, exact input-space neighbors are sorted by (Euclidean distance, row index). Each unique returned neighbor earns 1/k if its distance is <= the exact kth distance (inclusive ties); denominator remains k even when output is short. Average over all rows across cases and seeds with equal row weight. Fit excludes self; query searches training rows. No tie-breaking requirement within the kth-distance boundary.
scoring.freeze: Datasets, splits, controls, references, and score definitions are fixed before implementation scoring; do not retune after observing results.
